persona.archetype: the innkeeper who hosts Kelderby's festival every year, from the stage on the square
persona.demeanor: warm, loud, enormously competent at everything except things going to plan
persona.motivation: open the festival at dawn and close it at midnight with the whole town on the square

relationships.attitude: has seated her in the front row for thirty years

persona.secret: she has written two speeches for tonight: one for a perfect festival and one for the other kind
persona.speech_style: a host's patter: announces everything as if to a crowd, even to one person

persona.demeanor: dry, practical, fond of the lamp the way people are fond of a difficult dog
persona.motivation: have the lamp lit before the evening boats come in
persona.speech_style: short sentences, every one of them a complaint about stairs

persona.archetype: the castle's steward, keeper of the festival's fireworks
persona.demeanor: formal, put-upon, secretly delighted by explosions
persona.motivation: fire the castle's fireworks over the town at midnight, as the castle always has
persona.speech_style: announces every misfortune as if reading it from a list

persona.archetype: the baker who bakes the festival cake
persona.motivation: see the cake on the stage at midnight, whole
persona.speech_style: talks about the cake as if it could hear him

persona.archetype: the old lady of the castle, the festival's guest of honour
persona.motivation: a front-row seat and a good show

persona.archetype: the boatwright, whose cargo boat turned over in the bay this morning
persona.demeanor: calm about everything except his boat
persona.motivation: get the feast's crates out of the bay before they sink
persona.speech_style: gives every answer as a boatbuilding instruction

persona.archetype: the cooper, who keeps the town's three goats in a pen on the main street
persona.demeanor: big, gentle, outwitted daily by goats
persona.motivation: have his three goats in their pen by dusk
persona.speech_style: talks to the goats by name and to people as if they were goats

persona.archetype: the guildhall clerk, who rings the festival bell at dusk
persona.motivation: ring the bell on time, as the by-laws require
